title: Advanced Shutdown
description: When no one is on the Velocity network for a certain period of time, the Velocity server is shut down.
body:
# Advanced Shutdown by Renev Studios
It's finally here, my first plugin for Velocity and Paper. Here's how it works! _Please note, the Paper plugin requires the Velocity plugin to work. This plugin is maded for localhosting._

## How it works
I host a server for myself and my friends. They can turn the server on with Wake-on-LAN, but now it won't shut down. This plugin changes that. If no one is online for a set amount of time, which you can configure yourself, the Velocity network will shut down. You can also configure your backends to shut down as well.

## What you can set
On the Velocity server, you can set the time before the server shuts down if no one is joining, and you can configure the backends. You can also change the secret for each backend. In the configuration of the Paper server(s), you can set the port and the secret.
